Definition: from G511; superior, i.e. (locally) more remote:--upper.
BiblicalUsage: Paul comes into the upper coasts on his way to Ephesus, travelling the inland road rather than the coast. The word means the higher, more remote country, the uplands away from the sea.
TheologicalSignificance: One word for the upper country carries no doctrine of its own; its interest is the journey, that Paul reached Ephesus by the inland road.
